description: This file defines a set of React UI components for building a customizable select dropdown, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide-react icons. It includes components such as Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, and others, with styling and behavior customized for the project.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Root component for the select dropdown, rendering the Radix UI primitive.

methods.name: SelectContent
methods.description: Component rendering the dropdown content with positioning and animations.

methods.name: SelectLabel
methods.description: Label for a group of select items.

methods.name: SelectScrollUpButton
methods.description: Button for scrolling up within the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectScrollDownButton
methods.description: Button for scrolling down within the dropdown list.

methods.name: SelectTrigger
methods.description: Component that triggers the dropdown to open.
